quarterly_data.signal: Customer Axe Compute: neocloud Axe Compute (NASDAQ: AGPU) signed a multi-year strategic partnership with Penguin Solutions for its Axe Compute Build build-to-order program and has selected Penguin for multiple sites, including large GPU clusters, for AI infrastructure deployments designed, owned and operated by Axe Compute. Penguin will add expert-led deployment and operational services for specified GPU cluster sites, including its ClusterWareAI operating system software for managing GPU cluster operations at scale and 24x7 network operations center coverage. The partnership is intended to speed time to market as Axe Compute works to bring more than $3.45 billion in contracted customer AI infrastructure projects (Axe Compute's own contracted projects, not Penguin's) to production globally. Penguin CEO Kash Shaikh: the AI Factory Platform's 'rare combination of OEM-like differentiated products and deep systems integration expertise' helps customers like Axe Compute accelerate project delivery and bring additional capacity online.
